d: (derivative of {L:μίγνυμι<SDBG:μίγνυμι:000000>} ‘to mix, to mingle,’ {D:63.10}) that which has been mixed
to mix or mingle, either of liquids or solids, often involving substances which do not normally go together
(derivative of φυράω ‘to mix substances’ such as flour, either with other dry substances or with water, not occurring in the NT) that which is mixed or kneaded
